node_features.measurement: Scaled (StandardScaler on train), heavily diluted by 377 unobserved 0-pads (std=0.219)

feature_scaling.scaling_leakage: None. StandardScaler strictly fit on train_df. Topology scaling is static.

pooling_readout_behavior.vulnerability: Localized attack anomalies on 1-2 observed nodes are massively diluted by the 377 unobserved nodes during the mean operation.

temporal_window_configuration.target_alignment: Predicts label of the final frame in the window (t)

identified_issues.description: The model uses a global mean pool over 396 nodes, but only 19 nodes have actual sensor data. An extreme anomaly at 1 sensor is divided by 396, rendering it invisible to the GRU as normal operational noise.

recommended_next_experiment: Phase 6H: Replace mean(dim=2) with Max Pooling or Mean+Max Pooling to preserve localized attack spikes.
